note: Family-run RV park one block off US-287 in Kit Carson, on the open plains; still finishing construction (playground and basketball court added). Wood fires are not allowed (high winds); propane fire pits and grills are. --Claude
summary: Operator site live (phone 719-297-1970 matches) with a ResNexus engine: 25 full-hookup 20/30/50-amp sites (16 back-in 65-70 ft, 9 pull-through 85 ft), $38/$44 for 2026 and 2027, showers, laundry, wifi, open year-round. Gate: no gateway within 40 km; $44 is under US$50. Long-stay: weekly/monthly rates exist, but nightly is the main sale (22 of 25 sites open on a November weeknight). Pin on the property at the entry road; imagery predates the finished sites. Note trimmed of price, hookup and length facts.
flags: Engine has no rig-type choice (sites are classed Back In / Pull Through only), so there is no motorhome-vs-van type to choose.
